code: import Cookies from"js-cookie";import Axios from"axios";const baseURL='';const instance=Axios.create();instance.defaults.withCredentials=true;instance.interceptors.request.use(config=>{const accessToken=Cookies.get('access_token');if(accessToken){config.headers.Authorization="Bearer ".concat(accessToken);}return config;});export const Api={async loadItems(){return await instance.get("".concat(baseURL,"/api/v1/public/items"));},async addNewItem(body){return await instance.post("".concat(baseURL,"/api/v1/public/items"),JSON.stringify(body),{headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}});},async removeItem(uid){return await instance.delete("".concat(baseURL,"/api/v1/public/items/").concat(uid));}};
